scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/app build && pnpm -C packages/mcp-server build && pnpm -C packages/dsh-bundle build
scripts.lint:sh: root=scripts; [ -d "$root" ] || { echo "lint:sh: 目录不存在：$root" >&2; exit 1; }; test -n "$(find "$root" -name '*.sh' -print -quit)" || { echo "lint:sh: 没有可检查的 *.sh 脚本：$root" >&2; exit 1; }; find "$root" -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check-ci-parity && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:sh && pnpm lint-sh-selftest && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm depcruise && pnpm knip
